001: Excuse me, I'd like to open an account. What do I need to do?
You can do it at the counter. Do you have your seal and ID with you?
Yes, I brought my passport and my seal.
Then please fill out this application form. Once you're done, I'll call you.
Thank you. It might take me a little while to fill it out.
No problem. There's no need to rush, so take your time.
002: Excuse me, I lost my ATM card.
That's too bad. Let's take care of it right away. Do you know around when you lost it?
I used it at the ATM at the station a little while ago, so I think it was after that.
Understood. I'll stop the card right away. Your new card will arrive in about a week.
It's a problem if I can't withdraw cash until then.
You can withdraw money at the counter today, so don't worry.
003: I'd like to make an international transfer. Can I do that here?
Yes, you can. I'll need the recipient's bank name, account number, and the amount.
The amount is one hundred thousand yen. How much is the fee?
It depends on the destination country, but it's about three thousand to five thousand yen.
I see, that's more expensive than I expected.
Yes, it is. If you're not in a hurry, a regular transfer should be fine.
004: I'd like to check my monthly withdrawals. What should I do?
If you update your passbook, you can check the details.
I left my passbook at home. Can I check online instead?
Yes, if you sign up for internet banking, you can check anytime.
That's convenient. Can I sign up right away?
Yes, if you take care of it at the counter, you can use it starting today.
005: Could you tell me about the interest rates for fixed deposits?
Sure. Right now, a one-year term has an annual rate of zero point one percent.
That's really low. Are there any other products with better conditions?
Foreign currency deposits have higher interest rates, but there's the risk of exchange rate fluctuations.
I see. Considering the risk, I'd better not go with that.
That's right. I think it's best to choose something within your comfort zone.
006: Excuse me, I'd like to get a new passbook.
Certainly. So all the pages in your passbook are full.
Yes, I just used up the very last page.
Then I'll make a new passbook for you here. It will take a little time.
It'll be ready in about ten minutes, so please have a seat.
007: I'd like to change my address on file at the bank. Can I do that at the counter?
Yes, you can. Do you have a driver's license or a document showing your address?
Would my My Number card be okay?
Yes, that's fine. Then please write your new address on this form.
Yes, the process is all done. Thank you very much.
008: Excuse me, I don't know how to use the ATM. Could you show me?
Of course. First, insert your card here.
So I put it in like this. What do I do next?
Enter your PIN, and then select "Withdrawal."
Done. I just choose the amount on the screen, right?
Yes, that's right. Once the bills come out, don't forget to take your card.
009: I'm thinking about taking out a loan. Can I get some advice?
Yes, of course. Could you tell me the amount you'd like and the purpose?
I want to buy a car, so I'd like to borrow about two million yen.
Understood. Then I'll need documents to verify your income and place of work.
A withholding statement and a copy of your driver's license should be enough.
010: I'd like to close my account. How do I go about it?
Certainly. Do you have your ATM card, passbook, and seal with you?
Yes, I brought everything. I've already withdrawn all the balance.
Then please fill out this account closure form. I'll confirm everything at the counter at the end.
Is that all for the process?
Yes, your account is now closed. Thank you very much for banking with us all this time.
